lines: We struggled a bit because there were so many of them, but somehow we had managed to defeat all of the Incubi.
Shikanosuke, the ghost you saw, was it one of these guys?
N-No! The ghost was a pale and very beautiful woman!!!
Yeah, the other day we met Gonza at the castle ruins and had a little skirmish...
That's when he said to Sakura-sensei, "After I'm done with the ghost woman, I'll definitely kill you."
What if this ghost woman is pretty strong and fought off Gonza like Sakura-sensei did?
Gotcha... let's hope that's not the case...
Anyway, it looks like there's definitely something going on here!
We can't just leave those demons wandering around, so let's search this cave a bit more.
We readied our weapons and headed deeper into the cave.
